QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Angelic Buster's Message

QuestInfo.2: You delivered Angelic Buster's message to \r\n#bKaiser#k, but he kept making weird noises. It was hard to tell whether he was cheering or screaming. One thing is certain. \r\n#bHis morale is through the roof.#k
